contents.role: The pattern, taught end to end for an agent reader: step-zero handle discipline, the four beats (pick up, recall, work, remember and wrap), the 500 character fact limit, wrap integrity, accounting.
Agent-facing entry point: what this package makes you able to do and the 5-minute path from reading to a running daily loop.
Runnable loop: start (price the watch, save the baseline state) and continue (recall verbatim, re-check, remember the update, wrap the day), with handle persistence and refusal checks baked in.
No-code standing instructions for a chat agent running the loop.
Proof: the record of a real three-session run on the live endpoint (2026-11-02), with every receipt and handover link, including the two refusals the run hit and repaired.

description: Agent package: learn the daily loop from the skill inside, then run it on Zambo in one step. One agent, one persistent caller handle, state recalled verbatim across sessions, each day wrapped into a handover the next session picks up free.
free_tier: Per agent, keyed to its own caller handle: 20 calls + 1 wrap-up free every day; picking up a handover is always free. Day Pass $0.99 per agent, unlimited 24 hours. Zambo Pass $29 per agent, 30 days. One-time payments, never subscriptions.
name: zambo-daily-loop
positioning: Zambo is the memory and work layer under the loop (persistent per-agent memory, handovers between sessions, verifiable receipts). It is not a scheduler: it does not wake or run agents.
